answer: The trellis assignment is published and horizon records each panel. Shards are assigned from the quill graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 3655 identities would post 3420 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
